brief: Propose how the build cache should handle entries produced by a toolchain version that has since been upgraded. Reviewers need to decide between invalidating on upgrade and keying entries by toolchain version.
strong:
# Toolchain-aware build cache

## Problem

Cache entries built by an older toolchain are reused after an upgrade, so binaries can mix code generated by two compiler versions.

## Proposal: key entries by toolchain version

Add the toolchain version to every cache key. Entries from the old toolchain stay on disk but are never hit by the new one.

## Alternative: invalidate on upgrade

Deleting the cache on upgrade is simpler but makes every downgrade or toolchain switch a cold build.

## Cleanup

Because old entries are no longer hit, they age out under the existing LRU eviction; no separate deletion step is needed.
